options.label: Enable
options.description: After a perfect dodge the game's own moment of slow motion plays as usual; then the world stays slow while Dylan moves at normal speed. Off: as in the game.

options.label: Length
options.description: How long it lasts in all, the game's own 0.6 s of slow motion included.

options.label: World speed (%)
options.description: How fast everything but Dylan runs once the game's own slow motion is over. The game's own moment goes down to 1%.

options.label: Dylan's speed (%)
options.description: Dylan's speed during it. 100 = normal speed.

options.label: Warn when the mod cannot start
options.description: Shows a message at start when a game update, or another mod, stops the mod from working. A game update that changes nothing the mod needs shows no message.
